pages.title: Spectrograph
pages.text: A slit, a grating and a plate. Light comes in as one colour and leaves as a rainbow crossed with dark lines, and every line is an element's fingerprint.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 1$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.
Spreads light into $(item)Spectral Plates$(), and identifies the radium hidden in $(item)Raw Pitchblende$() by its lines.

$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (4 item and 1 fluid inputs, 2 and 0 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Chondrite Fragment, Fluorspar, Garnet, Interstellar Dust, Iron Nugget, Iron-Nickel, Magnetite, Meteoric Iron, Monazite Sand, Peridot, Presolar Grains, Quartz, Radium Salt, Rare Earth Oxide...
Starlight spread into a rainbow and caught on glass. The dark lines in it say which elements the light passed through.$(br2)Made in $(item)Spectrograph$().
Uraninite: heavy, black and pitch-glossy. Marie and Pierre Curie found two new elements in it by following its radioactivity.$(br2)
$(thing)Where these go$():$(li)$(item)Spectral Plate$(): Chondrite Fragment, Fluorspar, Garnet, Interstellar Dust, Iron Nugget and more$(li)$(item)Raw Pitchblende$(): Magnetite, Radium Salt
